title: Somatuline Predictive Factors in Acromegaly and NET
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to identify predictive factors for the response to Lanreotide treatment in Acromegaly as well as in Neuroendocrine Tumours.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Written informed consent (also mandatory in case of retrospective documentation of subject data)
* Diagnosis of acromegaly or NET with the intention to be treated with ATG or already on treatment with ATG

Exclusion Criteria:

* The subject has already been included in this study
* Participation in an interventional trial
study_population: Clinics and private practitioners who treat acromegaly and/or NET subjects with Somatuline Autogel® 60, 90 or 120 mg.
